narr: Heavy rain fell over portions of north-central Saguache County producing flooding and closing down CO Hwy 114 for several hours.
ev: Colorado DOT reports CO 114 closed due to flash flooding from CR 36 to FS road 840.
lsr: CDOT REPORTS CO 114 CLOSED DUE TO FLASH FLOODING FROM CR CC 36 TO FS ROAD 840.
